gen-gf-baumans-gf-hubot-sans: Commanding and tubelike, Baumans draws every line at a constant weight, with a c that gapes like an opened wrench. But Hubot Sans handles the quieter work, a contemporary text face with its e opened wide.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-arabic: A c shaped like a crescent wrench gives Baumans its commanding attitude. IBM Plex Sans Arabic is clean and approachable, with open apertures that keep a long stretch of text moving smoothly.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-devanaga: Baumans gives every bowl the full weight of its stems, which makes its letters feel solid and commanding. And IBM Plex Sans Devanagari loosens things up below, its curves running free without knotting at the ends.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-hebrew: Baumans keeps its stroke width constant from letter to letter, and its crescent-wrench c is the giveaway. And IBM Plex Sans Hebrew, with open, uncrowded mouths on its s and c, makes extended reading feel unhurried.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: One fixed nib width, wrench-shaped c: that's Baumans. IBM Plex Sans JP is professional and approachable, each curve ending in a clean, open gap that keeps longer reading moving along.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-kr: Baumans holds one line width from end to end, never swelling or tapering, with a c like an opened crescent wrench. It commands; IBM Plex Sans KR simply keeps every curve end open.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai: Baumans lays vertical and horizontal strokes at identical weight, giving its wrench-shaped c a commanding, distinctive look. IBM Plex Sans Thai does the quieter job, its c ends pointing apart like open pincers.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai-loo: One stroke thickness everywhere, plus a c like an opened crescent wrench, is what defines Baumans. But IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped is clean where Baumans is commanding, its curves refusing to close.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-imprima: Distinctive from the first glance, Baumans pairs a crescent-wrench c with strokes of a single thickness. And Imprima, neutral and approachable, keeps text flowing with smooth, tube-like lines and flared terminals.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-inclusive-sans: A c like a crescent wrench, set in strokes of one thickness, makes Baumans instantly recognizable. Baumans is built to command a line, but Inclusive Sans is built to carry text, its round letters matching their stems.
